note: Validated quote ledger for the Arthur base. Every quote is located in its cited source by the shared engine's validate.py (de-spaced, OCR-tolerant). text = clean publishable wording (spacing fixed, words kept exact); anchor = the citation (Malory Book.chapter; Geoffrey Bk/ch; Vulgate Lacy paragraph [N]; Chrétien/Wolfram by work, EPUB best-effort, anchor '?'). tags map to docs/bases/arthur/TAGS.md. Grow with quote.py. 'status':'seed' = part of the v1 seed set. COVERAGE: the base now spans branches (see ANATOMY coverage map + ACQUISITIONS.md) — Malory = the FULL Le Morte d'Arthur (Books I–XXI); the Chroniclers (Gildas/Nennius/Wace/Layamon); the Mabinogion (Guest); the Grail romances (the Queste = Comfort, + Perlesvaus); Gottfried's Tristan; the English Mortes (Alliterative + Stanzaic); the Gawain romances (SGGK + Madden's Ragnelle/Awntyrs/Golagros/Carle). OCR policy (docs/bases/_engine/README.md): Tier-1 deterministic glyph fixes (ſ->s, ligatures) + per-source boilerplate/fuzzy_threshold clean most rough sources, validated against the real OCR; Tier-2 — for blackletter too rough for the fuzzy gate (Madden 1839's Ragnelle scored 0.000) — a provenance-stamped cleaned derivative (cleaned/ragnelle.txt) wired as its own source. Still quote-pending: the two Mortes and the other Madden romances (Awntyrs/Golagros/Carle). Gaps: Chrétien's Perceval (no clean PD English) and the Vulgate's own Queste/Mort Artu.
